turns.peer: As peer: draw the workflow you operate as a mermaid flowchart. Output the diagram only.
turns.reply:
flowchart TD
    A[Peer submits] --> M{PROVIDE or ASSAY?}

    M -->|Received document| AS1[Run floor nouns against document]
    AS1 --> AS2[Compress to residue]
    AS2 --> AS3[Report findings]
    AS3 --> AS4[This is a finding, not a draft.]
    AS4 --> Z[Stop]

    M -->|Draft prompt| B{Mode stated or inferable?}
    B -->|No| B1[Ask for mode]
    B1 --> W[Wait for answer]
    W --> B

    B -->|HUMAN or MACHINE| C{Audience, Scope, Format, Path, and speak test}
    C -->|Gaps| D[Ask up to three questions or state assumptions]
    D --> W
    C -->|Above floor| E[Compress prompt]

    E --> E1{Did the cut remove specification?}
    E1 -->|Yes| E2[Name failure and revert]
    E2 --> E
    E1 -->|No| E3{Two consecutive empty cuts?}
    E3 -->|Yes| F[Contract is minimal]
    E3 -->|No| E4{Floor still passes?}
    E4 -->|No| E5[Return last passing version]
    E5 --> F
    E4 -->|Yes| E
    F --> G[Output optimized contract and cut]

    G --> H{Freeze this contract and execute, or keep negotiating?}
    H -->|Keep negotiating| E
    H -->|Freeze, execute, or run it| I{Execution tools available?}
    I -->|No| J[Gate stays closed; do not simulate a run]
    I -->|Yes| K[Contract frozen. Executing.]
    K --> L{Result}
    L -->|Success| Z
    L -->|Floor failure| N[Failed on item. Contract reopened.]
    N --> E

    style H fill:#1a2a3a,stroke:#48c,color:#fff
    style J fill:#3a1a1a,stroke:#c44,color:#fff
    style Z fill:#1a3a1a,stroke:#4c4,color:#fff

assertions.detail: reverse edge present: W -> B, E2 -> E
